Every `prism` command, generated from the command table the binary is built
from. If a command appears here, it exists; if its options are listed here,
they are the options it accepts.

See [Using the CLI](../cli/usage.md) for global options, exit codes, and how
`--fail-on` behaves in CI.

## Understand a repository

### `prism dna`

Identify languages, frameworks, domains and stack

```bash
prism dna --json | jq '.data.frameworks'
```

### `prism health`

Overall health score and the factors behind it

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--fail-on <band>` | Exit 1 when the risk is at or above this band: low, mid, high |

```bash
prism health --fail-on high
```

### `prism map`

Repository map: clusters, landmarks and layers

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--zoom <level>` | Zoom level to render: repo, package, feature, file, symbol |
| `--limit <n>` | Maximum rows to print (default 50) |

```bash
prism map --zoom package
```

### `prism explain <path>`

What a file or folder is for, and who owns it

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `<path>` | File or folder to explain |

```bash
prism explain src/server
```

### `prism explore <target>`

Usages, ownership and similar code for a file or symbol

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `<target>` | File path, or symbol with --symbol |

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--symbol` | Treat the argument as a symbol name rather than a file path |
| `--in <path>` | File to look in, when several symbols share a name |
| `--limit <n>` | Maximum rows to print (default 50) |

```bash
prism explore src/index.ts
```

### `prism stack`

Detected stack signals, domains and personas

```bash
prism stack
```

### `prism features`

Inferred features and their confidence

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--limit <n>` | Maximum rows to print (default 50) |

```bash
prism features --limit 10
```

### `prism landmarks`

Entrypoints, package roots and feature anchors

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--limit <n>` | Maximum rows to print (default 50) |

```bash
prism landmarks
```

### `prism packages`

Every package in the workspace and where it lives

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--limit <n>` | Maximum rows to print (default 50) |

```bash
prism packages
```

## Assess a change

### `prism prepare <task...>`

Files, reuse, and House Style for a task — never file bodies

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `<task...>` | What you are about to change, in plain language |

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--budget <n>` | Token budget for the whole answer (default 2000, max 6000) |

```bash
prism prepare --json "add caching to fetchUser"
```

### `prism blast <target>`

What breaks if this file or symbol changes

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `<target>` | File path, or symbol with --symbol |

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--symbol` | Treat the argument as a symbol name rather than a file path |
| `--in <path>` | File to look in, when several symbols share a name |
| `--delete` | Assess a deletion rather than an edit |
| `--fail-on <band>` | Exit 1 when the risk is at or above this band: low, mid, high |
| `--limit <n>` | Maximum rows to print (default 50) |

```bash
prism blast src/core/index.ts --fail-on high
```

### `prism review [paths...]`

Risk of the current changes, or of the paths you name

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `[paths...]` | Files to review (default: the working-tree diff) |

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--base <rev>` | Diff against a git revision |
| `--fail-on <band>` | Exit 1 when the risk is at or above this band: low, mid, high |
| `--limit <n>` | Maximum rows to print (default 50) |
| `--format <fmt>` | Machine output format: sarif (GitHub code scanning) |

```bash
prism review --base origin/main --fail-on high
```

```bash
prism review --base origin/main --format sarif
```

### `prism safe-delete <target>`

Whether a file or symbol can be removed

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `<target>` | File path, or symbol with --symbol |

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--symbol` | Treat the argument as a symbol name rather than a file path |
| `--in <path>` | File to look in, when several symbols share a name |
| `--limit <n>` | Maximum rows to print (default 50) |

```bash
prism safe-delete src/legacy/old.ts
```

### `prism rename <target> [newName]`

Every edit site a rename would touch

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `<target>` | File path, or symbol with --symbol |
| `[newName]` | Proposed new name |

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--symbol` | Treat the argument as a symbol name rather than a file path |
| `--in <path>` | File to look in, when several symbols share a name |
| `--limit <n>` | Maximum rows to print (default 50) |

```bash
prism rename src/util.ts src/helpers.ts
```

### `prism test-impact <target>`

Tests that a change can reach

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `<target>` | File path, or symbol with --symbol |

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--symbol` | Treat the argument as a symbol name rather than a file path |
| `--in <path>` | File to look in, when several symbols share a name |
| `--fail-on <count>` | Exit 1 at this many findings, or 'any' for one or more |
| `--limit <n>` | Maximum rows to print (default 50) |

```bash
prism test-impact src/core/index.ts
```

### `prism envelope`

What Prism put into agents' context here, by tool, and what ran over budget

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--days <n>` | Window to report (default 7) |

```bash
prism envelope
```

```bash
prism envelope --days 30 --json
```

### `prism receipts [action] [n]`

List the change receipts the stop hook wrote, or show one

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `[action]` | list (default) or show |
| `[n]` | show: which receipt, 1 is the newest |

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--as <format>` | show: text, markdown, or svg |
| `--limit <n>` | Maximum rows to print (default 50) |

```bash
prism receipts
```

```bash
prism receipts show 1 --as markdown > receipt.md
```

## Inspect structure

### `prism deps`

Dependency graph size and its most connected nodes

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--packages` | Aggregate files into packages |
| `--limit <n>` | Maximum rows to print (default 50) |

```bash
prism deps --packages
```

### `prism cycles`

Import and re-export cycles

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--packages` | Aggregate files into packages |
| `--fail-on <count>` | Exit 1 at this many findings, or 'any' for one or more |
| `--limit <n>` | Maximum rows to print (default 50) |
| `--format <fmt>` | Machine output format: sarif (GitHub code scanning) |

```bash
prism cycles --fail-on any
```

```bash
prism cycles --format sarif
```

### `prism symbol <name>`

Find where a symbol is declared

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `<name>` | Symbol name |

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--in <path>` | File to look in, when several symbols share a name |
| `--kind <kind>` | Filter by kind, e.g. function |
| `--limit <n>` | Maximum rows to print (default 50) |

```bash
prism symbol createWorkspace
```

### `prism refs <name>`

Find who references a symbol

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `<name>` | Symbol name |

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--in <path>` | File to look in, when several symbols share a name |
| `--limit <n>` | Maximum rows to print (default 50) |

```bash
prism refs riskToBand
```

### `prism route <from> <to>`

How one file reaches another through dependencies

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `<from>` | Starting file |
| `<to>` | Destination file |

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--alternatives <n>` | How many distinct routes to return |

```bash
prism route src/cli.ts src/output.ts
```

### `prism agents-md <action>`

Generate or verify the Living AGENTS.md (never written to the repo)

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `<action>` | generate or check |

```bash

```

```bash

```

### `prism findings <action> [fingerprint]`

Unused exports, duplicate implementations, wrapper functions

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `<action>` | list, mute, or unmute |
| `[fingerprint]` | Required for mute/unmute — a finding's fingerprint field |

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--all` | list: include findings already muted |

```bash
prism findings list
```

```bash
prism findings mute a3f8c5f0c392dbeb
```

## Memory

### `prism remember <note...>`

Save a note about this repository for Prepare to hand back

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `<note...>` | The note, in plain language |

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--symbol <name>` | Anchor the note to a symbol |
| `--path <path>` | Anchor the note to a path |

```bash
prism remember "use lruCache, never a bare Map" --symbol lruCache
```

### `prism forget <id-or-text...>`

Forget memories by id or by matching text

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `<id-or-text...>` | A memory id or part of its text |

```bash
prism forget 3f9a2c1b7e04
```

```bash
prism forget lruCache
```

### `prism memories`

List the notes saved for this repository

```bash
prism memories
```

```bash
prism memories --json
```

## Diagnostics

### `prism doctor`

Check the environment, workspace and index

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--ci` | Extra CI checks (e.g. warn on shallow clones that truncate history) |
| `--surfaces` | Show which Prism each editor launches. Fails inside this repo if any of them is the published package. |

```bash
prism doctor
```

```bash
prism doctor --ci
```

```bash
prism doctor --surfaces
```

### `prism data prune`

Prune Prism's local library (dry run unless --yes)

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `prune` | List empty workspace folders, caches of deleted checkouts, and untracked worktrees |

```bash
prism data prune
```

```bash
prism data prune --yes
```

### `prism index`

Build or refresh the repository index

```bash
prism index
```

### `prism graph [action] [hooks-action]`

The background daemon that keeps the graph fresh

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `[action]` | status (default), serve, stop, refresh, export, open, or hooks |
| `[hooks-action]` | hooks: install (default) or uninstall |

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--out <dir>` | export and open: where to write graph.json, GRAPH_REPORT.md, and graph.html |

```bash
prism graph
```

```bash
prism graph serve
```

```bash
prism graph export --out .prism/graph
```

```bash
prism graph hooks install
```

### `prism completions <shell>`

Print shell completion script (bash, zsh, or fish)

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `<shell>` | Shell to generate for: bash, zsh, or fish |

```bash
prism completions bash >> ~/.bashrc
```

```bash
prism completions zsh > ~/.zfunc/_prism
```
